[previewyoutube=AwMZNlaa7TY;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]










Introduction

Hello everyone, and welcome! We're excited to introduce The Circle Move; a game developed by OONY Team using Unreal Engine 5. This project was a big challenge for us, but also a huge step forward. Every new experience comes with its own learning curve—kind of like switching from riding a motorcycle to driving a car. You must adjust, stay flexible, and adapt to new ways of doing things.

To understand how we got here, let’s take a quick look at our journey as a team.



The Story of OONY TEAM

Back in 2016, the idea of starting a game studio first came to us. But we knew that before we could make it a reality, we had a lot to learn.

Fast forward to April 23, 2023—we officially launched, The Infinity Road.

🎥 Watch the trailer

[previewyoutube=_0P2M5nVWbE;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]










It taught us so much and helped us define our style and identity as a studio.

Then came June 17, 2024, when we released Is It a Dream.

🎥 Watch the trailer

[previewyoutube=9Hz5K8Lso_c;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]










This was a big breakthrough for us, featuring more complex mechanics and level design. The game was well received, which gave us the confidence to push even further.

On January 31, 2025, we launched Bolin Dash.

🎥 Watch thetrailer

[previewyoutube=gxaG886dXm4;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]










We were thrilled when Bolin Dash placed in the top 10 out of 350 games in a competition we entered. It was a huge moment for us, proving that we were heading in the right direction.

Now, it's time to move forward with our next game: The Circle Move. Let’s dive into what makes it special!

Gameplay & Features
I won’t spoil too much, but here’s a quick idea of what to expect:

First-person perspective: You play as an unknown character, solving puzzles and interacting with the environment.
Exploration-based gameplay: The game is all about discovering secrets and using logic to progress.
Smooth movement: You can freely explore different areas without restrictions.
Item collection: Gather tools and clues to help you solve puzzles.
The narrative unfolds through the environment, creating an atmosphere filled with mystery, suspense, and a touch of horror.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44025281/a7a7a01119829d59c330fc70d0fce9875174ee1e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44025281/f7532467ac28bedfcf1837e005320207bb87d99a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44025281/f7bfccc2100d55e8ff232d1f965ecb7dd5c78749.png[/img]

Explore a strange and mysterious world and challenge your mind with intricate puzzles.

System Requirements

Minimum:

Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
OS: Windows® 10 64-bit / Windows® 11 64-bit
Processor: AMD Ryzen™ 5 / Intel® Core™ i5
Memory: 16 GB RAM
Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 1660 or AMD Radeon RX 5500 XT
DirectX: Version 12
Storage: 2 GB available space (SSD is recommended for improved performance)
Additional Notes: the game may run on hardware below the minimum requirements

Recommended:

Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
OS: Windows® 10 64-bit / Windows® 11 64-bit
Processor: AMD Ryzen™ 5 / Intel® Core™ i5
Memory: 16 GB RAM
Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® RTX 2060 or AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT
DirectX: Version 12
Storage: 2 GB available space (SSD is recommended for improved performance)
Additional Notes: Graphics settings can be adjusted in-game to match your system's capabilities for the best experience.
 
Final Thoughts

Thanks for reading! We can’t wait for you to experience The Circle Move for yourself, and we’ll see you in the next game!

The Circle Move Available Now for Free on PC in Game jolt and itch to download and Play the game.
